world.title: HTLS 2026 LIVE: High parameter of success is a disadvantage in terms of nepotism, says Imtiaz Ali
world.summary: Imtiaz Ali discussed the challenges of high success parameters, linking them to nepotism, during the HT Leadership Summit 2026. The event featured prominent figures such as External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar, Samajwadi Party leader Akhilesh Yadav, Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata, and former US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, addressing topics like global dynamics, AI, and trade relations.

world.title: Archbishop Waldemar Stanislaw Sommertag appointed Apostolic Nuncio to India
world.summary: Pope Leo XIV has appointed Archbishop Waldemar Stanislaw Sommertag, 58, as the new Apostolic Nuncio to India, effective November 14. Born in Wiecbork, Poland, on February 6, 1968, he was ordained a priest for the Diocese of Pelplin on May 30, 1993. Sommertag's appointment marks a significant role within the Catholic Church's diplomatic mission in India.

world.title: Trump tells advisers he may hold off on Iran attacks barring new provocations, sources say
world.summary: President Donald Trump has informed senior advisers that he may delay military action against Iran unless new provocations arise. This decision comes after recommendations from Saudi Arabia and Turkiye to avoid strikes. Trump’s stance reflects a cautious approach, focusing on the potential for further escalation from Iran or its allied forces, particularly the Houthis in Yemen.

business.title: TVS Norton Atlas GT, Manx R Patented In India - Launch 2027?
business.summary: TVS Motor has patented the Norton Atlas GT Tourer and Manx R Supersport in India, ahead of the brand's launch. The acquisition of Norton Motorcycles by TVS in 2020 has led to this development. The launch of these models is anticipated in 2027, marking a significant step in reviving the iconic British motorcycle brand in the Indian market.

business.title: Open-source AI without Jensen
business.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's resignation poses challenges for the US open model ecosystem development. His departure is seen as a significant setback, yet Nvidia remains financially committed to supporting open models. The aim is to prevent power concentration among a limited number of customers, fostering a more equitable landscape in artificial intelligence and promoting broader access to open-source technologies.

business.title: Marco Rubio rewrote CIA assessment on Jensen Huang's alleged China spy link and used more forceful language: Report
business.summary: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio allegedly revised a CIA intelligence assessment regarding Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's purported connections to China. According to a Washington Post report, Rubio's version employed more forceful and assertive language than the original document. The changes reflect Rubio's stance on national security concerns related to Huang's potential ties with Chinese interests.

technology.title: Get wired: the 12 best wired headphones, earbuds, IEMs, players and hi-fi gifts of 2026, all picked by an audio expert
technology.summary: An audio expert has curated a list of the 12 best wired headphones, earbuds, IEMs, players, and hi-fi gifts for 2026. The selection emphasizes a return to retro music trends, encouraging users to explore physical media like CDs and cassette tapes instead of streaming services. This reflects a growing appreciation for traditional audio experiences in a digital age.

technology.title: Samsung announces Google co-developed smart glasses pricing and sale details
technology.summary: Samsung has announced its new smart glasses, developed in collaboration with Google, Gentle Monster, and Warby Parker. These intelligent eyewear pieces feature hands-free artificial intelligence, integrating Google’s Gemini AI into fashionable frames designed for daily use. The company has also revealed pricing and sale details, marking a significant step in merging technology with everyday fashion.

technology.title: Samsung announces Google co-developed pricing and sale details of its smart glasses
technology.summary: Samsung has announced its new smart glasses, developed in collaboration with Google, Gentle Monster, and Warby Parker. The eyewear features integrated Google’s Gemini AI, designed for hands-free use in daily life. This innovative product aims to blend artificial intelligence with fashionable design, making it suitable for everyday wear. Pricing and sale details have also been revealed.

sports.title: ‘I’m enjoying myself’ - Ronald Araujo speaks out after Uruguay’s win over Argentina
sports.summary: Ronald Araujo expressed his joy following Uruguay's victory over Argentina, stating, “I’m enjoying myself; I’m enjoying being back to doing what I love most: being out on the pitch and representing the national team.” He emphasized the significance of the national team to him and the emotions he experiences whenever he has the opportunity to play.

sports.title: 'He actually got emotional': R Ashwin reveals Virat Kohli's reaction to his retirement decision
sports.summary: Ravichandran Ashwin shared details of an emotional conversation with Virat Kohli at the Gabba during the 2024-25 Border-Gavaskar Trophy. Ashwin revealed that Kohli became visibly emotional upon hearing about his retirement decision. The discussion highlighted their close friendship and the impact of such decisions on teammates. Ashwin's retirement marks a significant moment in Indian cricket history.

sports.title: IND vs BHU Highlights, SAFF Championship: India survives late surge to beat Bhutan in semifinal
sports.summary: India defeated Bhutan in the SAFF Championship 2026 semifinal held in Dhaka, securing a place in the final. Despite a strong second-half effort from Bhutan, India maintained their lead. Key contributions came from players PV Vishnu and Chinglensana Singh, helping India continue their pursuit of a 10th championship title. The match showcased intense competition and determination from both teams.

health.title: Scientists are at last starting to understand endometriosis
health.summary: Scientists are making progress in understanding endometriosis, a condition that currently lacks a cure and has inadequate treatments. The causes remain largely unknown, and obtaining a diagnosis can take nearly nine years, often necessitating invasive procedures like laparoscopies. Improved understanding may lead to quicker diagnoses and better treatment options for those affected by this challenging condition.

health.title: World Diabetes Day 2026: Experts share irreversible harm pre-diabetes causes before symptoms even appear
health.summary: On World Diabetes Day 2026, health experts emphasized the significant, often irreversible damage caused by pre-diabetes, which can occur before any symptoms manifest. They highlighted the condition's potential to impair vision and increase the risk of severe complications. Authorities urged the public to take early action to mitigate these risks and improve overall health outcomes related to diabetes.

health.title: Can you reverse Type 2 diabetes in 90 days?
health.summary: Type 2 diabetes can potentially enter remission within 90 days, according to endocrinologist Dr. Chawla. Achieving this involves a combination of diet, exercise, weight loss, medication, and blood sugar monitoring. Some individuals with Type 2 diabetes have successfully reached remission, which is defined as having blood sugar levels return to normal without the need for medication.

science.title: Astronomers watched a planet vanish in space. Now they know why.
science.summary: Astronomers observed the planet TOI-2535 b, similar in size to Jupiter, transit its star for seven years until it unexpectedly disappeared from view. The planet had exhibited unusual behavior prior to its vanishing. Researchers suggest that larger celestial bodies may be obscuring TOI-2535 b, leading to its disappearance. This finding sheds light on the dynamics of exoplanetary systems.

science.title: The Leonid meteor shower peaks on the night of 17 to 18 November, with about 10 to 15 meteors an hour under dark skies, and in 1833 the same shower produced so many shooting stars that people thought
science.summary: The Leonid meteor shower will peak on the night of November 17-18, with an expected rate of 10 to 15 meteors per hour under optimal dark sky conditions. Historically, the 1833 Leonid shower was remarkable, producing an extraordinary number of shooting stars that astonished observers. This year's event presents a chance for skywatchers to experience a similar spectacle.

science.title: Mizzou Scientists Edit Rice Genes With AI Tool to Fight Bacterial Blight
science.summary: University of Missouri scientists have developed rice plants resistant to bacterial blight using the AI-designed gene editor OpenCRISPR-1. This advancement aims to combat one of the most damaging diseases affecting rice, a staple crop globally. The research highlights the potential of artificial intelligence in agricultural biotechnology, offering a promising solution to enhance food security and crop resilience.

entertainment.title: ‘Before they were my parents, they were children too’: Soha Ali Khan shares rare photos of Sharmila Tagore and Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi with Nehru
entertainment.summary: Soha Ali Khan commemorated Children’s Day, observed on November 14, by sharing rare throwback photos on Instagram. The images feature her mother, Sharmila Tagore, and father, Mansoor Ali Khan Pataudi, alongside India’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. The post highlights the significance of the day, celebrating the childhoods of notable figures in Indian history.

entertainment.title: Re:ZERO Season 5 Anime Officially Announced
entertainment.summary: Re:ZERO -Starting Life in Another World- Season 5 has been officially announced, accompanied by an ultra teaser visual. The original author, Tappei Nagatsuki, expressed gratitude for the production and support from fans. The announcement marks a significant milestone in the series, celebrating its continued popularity and the anticipation surrounding the upcoming season. Further details are expected in the future.

entertainment.title: Police announce diversions, parking curbs in South Mumbai from November 16
entertainment.summary: The Mumbai Traffic Police will implement temporary traffic restrictions, diversions, and parking curbs in South Mumbai from November 16 to November 19 due to a VVIP visit. Affected areas include Hutatma Rajguru Chowk, Ballard Pier, and several roads in the NCPA vicinity. Motorists are advised to plan their routes accordingly to avoid disruptions during this period.
